summary.one_liner: A Nix flake and Home Manager module that packages and deploys the OpenClaw AI assistant gateway declaratively on macOS and headless Linux.
summary.what_it_does: Packages the OpenClaw gateway (.#openclaw, .#openclaw-gateway) and a macOS app (.#openclaw-app) as Nix outputs, pinned to upstream stable releases. Home Manager options configure the gateway as a launchd service on macOS or a systemd user service on Linux, with OpenClaw config rendered from Nix under programs.openclaw.config. Runtime plugins such as Discord, Slack, WhatsApp or Copilot are installed by listing plugin ids in programs.openclaw.runtimePlugins, or by pinning npm/ClawHub specs with hashes in runtimePluginSources. Nix-packaged tool plugins (bundledPlugins, customPlugins) add CLI tools and agent skills to the gateway PATH. Workspace bootstrap files (AGENTS.md, SOUL.md, etc.) are managed declaratively. The README also documents a dual-instance (prod/dev) setup, secret handling via env or file paths, and a template flake (agent-first) for new users.
use_cases: Deploy OpenClaw gateway on macOS or Linux with Nix
Run an AI assistant reachable from Telegram or Discord
Pin and reproduce an OpenClaw installation across machines
Run prod and dev OpenClaw instances side by side
Install nix-packaged CLI tools and skills for an AI agent
how_to_run: Edit flake.nix placeholders (system, home.username, homeDirectory, bootstrap files, secrets)
macOS verify: launchctl print gui/$UID/com.steipete.openclaw.gateway | grep state
notable: Runtime plugins installed by Nix: OpenClaw CLI plugin install/update/uninstall are disabled in Nix mode (OPENCLAW_NIX_MODE=1), so config changes go through rebuilds
Pinned gateway tracks newest upstream stable OpenClaw release that passes Linux and macOS package checks, with mirrored v-tags
Tool plugins declare CLI packages and skills via an openclawPlugin flake output
Dual-instance support for prod and dev gateways with separate ports and configs
Secrets are meant to be materialized outside the Nix store and passed as env or file paths
caveats: Windows is out of scope; supports macOS (Apple Silicon) and Linux (x86_64, headless)
Not accepting pull requests; GitHub Issues not actively monitored; support is via Discord
Requires Nix with flakes enabled and familiarity with Home Manager; the README warns that Nix generation rollback does not reverse OpenClaw state migrations
keywords: run ai bot on my machine
